parsed.summary: The patch correctly quotes table names to avoid SQL syntax errors, but it could be improved for readability and maintainability.

issues.description: The patch introduces additional whitespace and line breaks, which may not align with the project's style conventions.
The patch could be made more readable by using parameterized queries instead of string formatting for SQL statements.
